# A contract needs two of three legal members, one security member and one product member (policy.star). Every sign-off is a file
# signed with ssh-keygen -Y sign and checked against allowed_signers. A key that the desk does not know is refused.
# Every window is 300 seconds. Sign-offs arrive inside it. The audit checks the chain, every signature, the close and the head.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:ssh-keygen] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
[!exec:flock] skip
[!exec:git] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

approvalsinit
approvalsfakes
approvalskeys ann lee lou luz sam pat outsider-mal
subst home/.approval/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env APPROVALS_DIR=$WORK/ops
env APPROVALS_WINDOW_SECONDS=300
env APPROVAL_POLL=1

exec obeereal check workflow ops/workflow.star
! stdout .
exec obeereal check workflow ops/audit.star
! stdout .

exec sh ops/scripts/submit.sh contract contract.md ann
exec obeereal item add approvals req-1 --title 'Sign off the contract' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitfile notices.log
grep '^version-req-1-' notices.log
grep 'lee,lou,luz,pat,paula,sam,sue' notices.log

# One legal member is not enough. A key that the desk does not know is refused.
exec signoff lee legal approve req-1 contract
exec signoff outsider-mal legal approve req-1 contract
exec signoff sam security approve req-1 contract
exec signoff pat product approve req-1 contract
# The tally takes the inbox first, so the four files are counted when it answers.
exec sh ops/scripts/tally.sh req-1
stdout '"status":"pending"'
stdout '"missing":\["legal"\]'
exec signoff lou legal approve req-1 contract
wait
stdout 'item req-1 finished'

! grep '^remind-' notices.log
grep -count=1 '^outcome-req-1 ann' notices.log
exec sh -c 'sh ops/scripts/audit.sh req-1 $(git hash-object home/.approval/docs/contract.md) $(jq -r .head home/.approval/certs/req-1.json)'
stdout 'chain ok'
stdout '\tsignoff\tlee\tlegal\tapprove\t'
stdout '\tsignoff\tlou\tlegal\tapprove\t'
stdout '\trefused\toutsider-mal\t'
stdout '\tclosed\t.*\tapproved\t'
exec sqlite3 state/local.db 'SELECT state FROM items WHERE id = "req-1"'
stdout '^closed$'

# Rows after the close do not hide a cut tail: the head from the close pins it.
exec sqlite3 home/.approval/ledger.db 'DROP TRIGGER events_no_delete; DELETE FROM events WHERE seq >= (SELECT seq FROM events WHERE type = "closed");'
! exec sh ops/scripts/audit.sh req-1
stderr 'REFUSE'
! exec sh -c 'sh ops/scripts/audit.sh req-1 $(git hash-object home/.approval/docs/contract.md) $(jq -r .head home/.approval/certs/req-1.json)'
stdout 'BROKEN the row'

-- body.txt --
{"doc":"contract","kind":"contract","author":"ann"}
-- contract.md --
The supplier delivers in 30 days.
-- home/.approval/config --
NOTIFY_API=http://notify.test
-- home/.approval/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
